[SWS_EM_01321] Minimum number of required synchronization re- quests
⌈
The attribute minimumNumberOfRequests shall define the minimum num-
ber of required synchronization requests (from the connected Deterministic-
Clients in the same domain) that are necessary to be received by the Determin-
isticSyncMaster to continue calculation of the next cycle.
⌋
